subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Data Breaches and Mass Theft
description: One-minute skill: Data Breaches and Mass Theft.

hook.text: In 2017, Equifax lost the personal data of 147 million Americans in a single breach.

buildup.text: Hackers exploited a known vulnerability that Equifax had failed to patch for months.

discovery.text: Names, Social Security numbers, birth dates, and addresses — everything needed for identity theft.

twist.text: Equifax executives sold stock before announcing the breach. Some faced insider trading charges.

climax.text: The breach affected nearly half the U.S. population. Most people couldn't do anything about it.

punchline.text: A company trusted to guard your data lost all of it.

quiz.question: How many Americans were affected by the 2017 Equifax breach?
